name: Image-based Volume Reconstruction
definition: Assembles registered 2D images into a 3D volume by assigning a voxel value to each point in 3D space, often using interpolation to create a denser volume than the input data allows.
summary: Image-based Volume Reconstruction assembles registered 2D images into a dense 3D volume by assigning voxel values and interpolating to fill gaps, distinguishing itself from methods that merely map indices or generate surface heightmaps.
